note: Primary: Steam announcement 'The Wolf Among Us Remastered OUT NOW!' (Telltale, 29 Oct 13:02Z): five playable Deleted Scenes, optional Noir Mode, launch discounts through 12 Nov, defining choices carry into The Wolf Among Us 2 for players signed in to a Telltale Account. Steam store AE 59.99 AED (regular 74.99), SA 46.79 SR, US $19.99 (regular $24.99), read 13:33Z. Footage: Steam Noir Mode trailer (colour to black and white at 12.5 s) and Announcement trailer (Bigby 40-48 s); title cards and the end slate avoided.
